title: Fix: the line ends that won't go away
hints: Trace `chomp_line` by hand on `"ok "` (length 3). Where does `end` point before the loop starts, and what character is under it?

`end` starts at `line + strlen(line)`, which is the `'\0'`, not the last real character. The loop asks whether the terminator is whitespace, so it never moves. It should be looking at the character *just before* `end`.
Test `end[-1]` (the same as `*(end - 1)`) in the loop condition: `while (end > line && isspace((unsigned char)end[-1]))`. Everything else can stay.
